cards.title: Message to clinician
cards.summary: Create a concise request for care.
cards.when_to_use: User knows they need care but struggles to explain the problem.
steps: State the request: appointment, advice, refill question, urgent assessment, accommodation, etc.

cards.title: Appointment question builder
cards.summary: Prioritize questions so limited appointment time covers the most important decisions.
steps: What are the most likely categories of cause you are considering?
What tests or monitoring are needed?
What should I do if symptoms worsen?
What medication side effects/interactions should I watch for?
